en: The image depicts a waterfront scene with multiple boats docked at a port. In the background, there are several historic buildings, including what appears to be a mosque with a minaret. The foreground features a boat with a canopy, moored at the dock, and some flags visible. The photograph is monochrome (black and white), giving it a vintage appearance. The upper left of the image contains printed text.
